The 'topology_boundary_auditor' gave a high mask confidence, but this only means the object is segmented, not that the internal boundaries are anatomically sharp. I agree with the Router's severity assessments but emphasize that the texture anomaly is the most significant defect, indicating an AI-generated or heavily processed image rather than a natural photograph.
